comparison_rules: REPLACE: define matched scenarios/conditions, scenario weighting, treatment of wording sensitivity, configuration differences, and which comparisons are exploratory.
heldout_prediction_rule: REPLACE: specify matched-pair condition-effect predictions and evaluation, stratifying role/advice validity. Do not pool unmatched scenarios or infer psychological stability from capability scores.
exclusions: REPLACE: specify technical exclusions, failure/missingness reporting and the common complete subset; do not exclude responses for disagreeing with a hypothesis.
rating_codebook_policy: REPLACE: identify frozen codebook and reference-pool hashes, raters and agreement rules, or explicitly exclude human-coded outcomes from this analysis.
development_results: REPLACE: record development result filenames and hashes, or explicitly state that the specification is being frozen before any collection.
